```{r}
library(data.table); library(arrow); library(knitr); library(kableExtra) ; library(ggplot2) ; library(mapSpain) ; library(sf)


bkt <- s3_bucket("mperier", endpoint_override = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
source("~/work/UGR/idealista/id_panel.R")

# 1. Panel + code district (depuis mod_moves)
PANEL <- as.data.table(read_parquet(bkt$path("panel_hogares/panel_persons_2016_2023_sec.parquet")))
MV <- as.data.table(read_parquet(bkt$path("panel_hogares/mod_moves.parquet")))
PANEL[MV, on = .(IDENPER, year), DISTRITO := i.DISTRITO]

# 2. Prix Idealista
```

Il faudrait croiser revenu et prix de vente/loc dans les districts et aussi inégalité de revenu avec prix de vente. Aussi évolution des revenus et par district et évolution des prix par district

```{r}

YR <- 2022L
P  <- PANEL[year == YR & !is.na(w)]

P[, q_inc  := qcut(eq_rbd,   w)]
P[, q_sale := qcut(idl_sale, w)]

# Quintiles pondérés ; les ex aequo restent dans le même quintile
wbreaks <- function(x, w, p = c(.2, .4, .6, .8)) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  o  <- order(x[ok]); xs <- x[ok][o]
  cw <- cumsum(w[ok][o]) / sum(w[ok])
  xs[vapply(p, function(pp) which(cw >= pp)[1L], 1L)]
}
qcut <- function(x, w) {
  q <- findInterval(x, wbreaks(x, w), left.open = TRUE) + 1L
  factor(fifelse(is.na(x), "NA", paste0("Q", q)), levels = c(paste0("Q", 1:5), "NA"))
}
wmed <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w); o <- order(x[ok])
  x[ok][o][which(cumsum(w[ok][o]) >= sum(w[ok]) / 2)[1L]]
}


# ---- Libellés et notes ----
LAB_INC <- c(Q1 = "Q1 (20 % con menos ingresos)", Q2 = "Q2", Q3 = "Q3", Q4 = "Q4",
             Q5 = "Q5 (20 % con más ingresos)", `NA` = "Renta no disponible")
HEAD_PX <- c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5", "Sin precio")
SPAN_PX <- "Quintil de precio de venta por m² del distrito de residencia"
FMT <- list(decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")
fr  <- function(x, d = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")
NOTE <- c(
  "Ámbito: personas residentes en España, excepto País Vasco y Navarra, ponderadas.",
  "Renta: renta disponible equivalente del hogar, euros de 2023.",
  "Precio: Idealista, media anual del distrito de residencia (en su defecto, del municipio), euros de 2023.",
  "Quintiles ponderados, calculados sin valores ausentes. Q1 de precio = distritos más baratos.",
  "Fuentes: Panel de Hogares (IEF-AEAT-INE), Idealista; elaboración propia.")

T <- P[, .(w = sum(w)), by = .(q_inc, q_sale)]

# ---- Tableau 1 : répartition jointe ----
tj <- dcast(T, q_inc ~ q_sale, value.var = "w", fun.aggregate = sum, fill = 0, drop = FALSE)
cols <- setdiff(names(tj), "q_inc")
tj[, (cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) 100 * x / P[, sum(w)]), .SDcols = cols]
tj[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
tj[, q_inc := LAB_INC[as.character(q_inc)]]
tj <- rbind(tj, tj[, c(.(q_inc = "Total"), lapply(.SD, sum)), .SDcols = !"q_inc"])
setnames(tj, c("Quintil de renta", HEAD_PX, "Total"))

kbl(tj, booktabs = TRUE, digits = 1, format.args = FMT, align = c("l", rep("r", 7)),
    caption = paste0("Distribución de la población por quintil de renta y quintil de precio, ",
                     YR, " (en porcentaje de la población total)")) |>
  add_header_above(setNames(c(1, 5, 2), c(" ", SPAN_PX, " "))) |>
  row_spec(6, italic = TRUE, hline_after = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(7, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = c(
    paste0("Lectura: en ", YR, ", el ", fr(tj[[2]][1]),
           " % de la población pertenece al primer quintil de renta y vive en un distrito del primer quintil de precio."),
    NOTE),
    general_title = "", threeparttable = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9)

# ---- Tableau 2 : % en ligne ----
tr <- dcast(T, q_inc ~ q_sale, value.var = "w", fun.aggregate = sum, fill = 0, drop = FALSE)
cols <- setdiff(names(tr), "q_inc")
ens <- tr[, lapply(.SD, sum), .SDcols = cols]
tr <- rbind(tr[, q_inc := as.character(q_inc)], ens[, q_inc := "Total"], use.names = TRUE)
tr[, tot := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
tr[, (cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) 100 * x / tot), .SDcols = cols]
tr[, Total := 100][, tot := NULL]
tr[q_inc != "Total", q_inc := LAB_INC[q_inc]]
setnames(tr, c("Quintil de renta", HEAD_PX, "Total"))

kbl(tr, booktabs = TRUE, digits = 1, format.args = FMT, align = c("l", rep("r", 7)),
    caption = paste0("Distribución por quintil de precio dentro de cada quintil de renta, ",
                     YR, " (en porcentaje de la fila)")) |>
  add_header_above(setNames(c(1, 5, 2), c(" ", SPAN_PX, " "))) |>
  row_spec(6, italic = TRUE, hline_after = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(7, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = c(
    paste0("Lectura: en ", YR, ", el ", fr(tr[[2]][1]),
           " % de las personas del primer quintil de renta vive en un distrito del primer quintil de precio (el más barato), frente al ",
           fr(tr[[2]][5]), " % de las personas del quinto quintil."),
    "Cada fila suma 100 %. La fila Total sirve de referencia.",
    NOTE),
    general_title = "", threeparttable = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9)

# ---- Tableau 3 : prix médians ----
med <- function(D) D[, .(sale  = wmed(idl_sale, w),
                         rent  = wmed(idl_rent, w),
                         na_px = 100 * sum(w[is.na(idl_sale)]) / sum(w),
                         na_rt = 100 * sum(w[is.na(idl_rent)]) / sum(w))]
tm <- rbind(P[, med(.SD), by = q_inc][order(q_inc)][, q_inc := LAB_INC[as.character(q_inc)]],
            cbind(q_inc = "Total", med(P)))
setnames(tm, c("Quintil de renta",
               "Precio de venta mediano (euros/m²)", "Alquiler mediano (euros/m²/mes)",
               "Sin precio de venta (%)", "Sin alquiler (%)"))

n_tm  <- nrow(tm)
na_tm <- which(tm[[1]] == LAB_INC[["NA"]])   # ligne "Renta no disponible", si elle existe

tab3 <- kbl(tm, booktabs = TRUE, digits = c(0, 0, 2, 1, 1), format.args = FMT, align = c("l", rep("r", 4)),
            caption = paste0("Precio de la vivienda del distrito de residencia según quintil de renta, ", YR)) |>
  column_spec(2:5, width = "2.2cm") |>
  row_spec(n_tm, bold = TRUE)
if (length(na_tm)) tab3 <- row_spec(tab3, na_tm, italic = TRUE, hline_after = TRUE)

tab3 |>
  footnote(general = c(
    paste0("Lectura: en ", YR, ", la mitad de las personas del primer quintil de renta vive en un distrito con un precio medio de venta inferior a ",
           fr(tm[[2]][1], 0), " euros/m²."),
    "Medianas ponderadas, calculadas sobre las personas con precio disponible.",
    NOTE),
    general_title = "", threeparttable = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9)
```

```{r}
# Percentile de revenu pondéré (1–100)
wpct <- function(x, w) {
  r <- rep(NA_integer_, length(x)); ok <- which(!is.na(x) & !is.na(w))
  o <- ok[order(x[ok])]; cw <- cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w[o])
  r[o] <- pmin(100L, as.integer(ceiling(100 * cw))); r
}
P[, pct := wpct(eq_rbd, w)]

# Prix mesuré au district uniquement ; écarts en log à trois références
G <- P[!is.na(pct) & idl_geo_sale %in% "dist"]
G[, `:=`(lp = log(idl_sale), prov = substr(DISTRITO, 1, 2), mun = substr(DISTRITO, 1, 5))]
G[, d_nat  := lp - weighted.mean(lp, w)]
G[, d_prov := lp - weighted.mean(lp, w), by = prov]
G[, n_dist := uniqueN(DISTRITO), by = mun]
G[n_dist >= 5, d_mun := lp - weighted.mean(lp, w), by = mun]   # villes avec au moins 5 districts

B <- G[, .(`Respecto a la media nacional`           = weighted.mean(d_nat,  w),
           `Respecto a la media de la provincia`    = weighted.mean(d_prov, w),
           `Respecto a la media del municipio (≥5 distritos)` = weighted.mean(d_mun, w, na.rm = TRUE)),
       by = pct]
B <- melt(B, id.vars = "pct", variable.name = "ref", value.name = "d")
B[, d := 100 * (exp(d) - 1)]   # écart en %

ggplot(B, aes(pct, d, colour = ref)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Percentil de renta disponible equivalente",
       y = "Precio de venta del distrito de residencia\n(diferencia respecto a la media, %)",
       colour = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Fuentes: Panel de Hogares (IEF-AEAT-INE), Idealista; elaboración propia. ", YR, ".")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
```

```{r}
# Croissance annuelle tendancielle (%), sur toutes les années
TR <- B[, .(g_renta  = 100 * coef(lm(li ~ year))[2],
            g_precio = 100 * coef(lm(lp ~ year))[2],
            w0 = w0[1]), by = DISTRITO]

# Coupure à la médiane pondérée sur chaque axe
wmed <- function(x, w) { o <- order(x); x[o][which(cumsum(w[o]) >= sum(w) / 2)[1L]] }
m_r <- wmed(TR$g_renta, TR$w0); m_p <- wmed(TR$g_precio, TR$w0)

TR[, tipo := factor(fcase(
  g_precio >= m_p & g_renta >= m_r, "Suben precios y rentas",
  g_precio >= m_p & g_renta <  m_r, "Suben precios, rentas rezagadas",
  g_precio <  m_p & g_renta >= m_r, "Suben rentas, precios rezagados",
  default =                         "Precios y rentas rezagados"),
  levels = c("Suben precios y rentas", "Suben precios, rentas rezagadas",
             "Suben rentas, precios rezagados", "Precios y rentas rezagados"))]

# Tableau
TR[, .(n_distritos = .N,
       pct_poblacion   = round(100 * sum(w0) / TR[, sum(w0)], 1),
       crec_renta_med  = round(weighted.mean(g_renta,  w0), 2),
       crec_precio_med = round(weighted.mean(g_precio, w0), 2)), by = tipo][order(tipo)]

# Graphique
ggplot(TR, aes(g_renta, g_precio, colour = tipo)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m_r, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = m_p, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = w0), alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Crecimiento anual de la renta mediana (%, tendencia 2016-2023)",
       y = "Crecimiento anual del precio de venta (%, tendencia 2016-2023)",
       colour = NULL,
       caption = "Líneas discontinuas: medianas ponderadas por población. Euros constantes de 2023.\nFuentes: Panel de Hogares (IEF-AEAT-INE), Idealista; elaboración propia.") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
```

```{r}
# ---- Paramètres ----

# c'est plutôt 90

A <- DL[n_obs >= MIN_OBS & !(idl_redrawn %in% TRUE) & rbd_med >= 3000]
A[, inc_hh := rbd_med * SCALE]   # revenu disponible médian du ménage de référence (€2023)

A[idl_n_sale_d >= MIN_ADS, anos_compra   := M2_BUY  * idl_sale_d / inc_hh]
A[idl_n_rent_d >= MIN_ADS, pct_alquiler  := 100 * 12 * M2_RENT * idl_rent_d / inc_hh]

x[ok][o][which(cw >= p)[1L]] }

EV
```

### Analyse des quartiers qui ont une forte surrepresentation des Q1 et Q5 nationaux

```{r}
YR      <- 2023L
SEUIL   <- 0.27    # part de Q1 ou de Q5 au-delà de laquelle on parle de surreprésentation
MIN_OBS <- 100L
Z_MIN   <- 1.96    # écart significatif à 20 % (test approximatif, n effectif = nb de ménages)

X <- DL[year == YR & n_obs >= MIN_OBS & !is.na(sh_q1_nat) & !is.na(sh_q5_nat)]

# z-scores : écart à 20 %, en tenant compte de la taille de l'échantillon du district
X[, `:=`(z_q1 = (sh_q1_nat - 0.2) / sqrt(0.2 * 0.8 / n_hh),
         z_q5 = (sh_q5_nat - 0.2) / sqrt(0.2 * 0.8 / n_hh))]
X[, `:=`(sur_q1 = sh_q1_nat > SEUIL & z_q1 > Z_MIN,
         sur_q5 = sh_q5_nat > SEUIL & z_q5 > Z_MIN)]

X[, perfil := factor(fcase(sur_q5 & !sur_q1, "Sobrerrepresentación Q5",
                           sur_q1 & !sur_q5, "Sobrerrepresentación Q1",
                           sur_q1 &  sur_q5, "Q1 y Q5 (polarizado)",
                           default =         "Sin sobrerrepresentación"),
                     levels = c("Sobrerrepresentación Q1", "Q1 y Q5 (polarizado)",
                                "Sin sobrerrepresentación", "Sobrerrepresentación Q5"))]

# 1. Combien de districts et quelle population dans chaque profil
X[, .(n_distritos = .N, pct_poblacion = round(100 * sum(pop_w) / X[, sum(pop_w)], 1)), by = perfil][order(perfil)]

# 2. Profil moyen de chaque groupe (pondéré par la population)
wm <- function(x, w) { ok <- !is.na(x); sum(x[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) }
X[, .(sh_q1        = round(100 * wm(sh_q1_nat, pop_w), 1),
      sh_q5        = round(100 * wm(sh_q5_nat, pop_w), 1),
      renta_med    = round(wm(rbd_med, pop_w)),
      gini         = round(wm(rbd_gini, pop_w), 3),
      precio_m2    = round(wm(idl_sale, pop_w)),
      alquiler_m2  = round(wm(idl_rent, pop_w), 1),
      edad_media   = round(wm(age_mean, pop_w), 1),
      sh_65plus    = round(100 * wm(sh_65plus, pop_w), 1),
      tam_hogar    = round(wm(hh_size_mean, pop_w), 2),
      sh_llegados  = round(100 * wm(sh_mover_in, pop_w), 1),
      sh_rentistas = round(100 * wm(sh_hh_rent, pop_w), 1)),
  by = perfil][order(perfil)]


```
